title: Hardware & USB Tethering Manager
summary: Shows USB devices (lsusb, or sysfs when usbutils is missing), USB network interfaces by kernel driver (rndis_host, cdc_ether, cdc_ncm, ipheth = phone tethering; qmi_wwan, cdc_mbim = modems), modem ports and WAN metrics.

items.title: Setup USB Tethering WAN (DHCP client)
items.description: Creates or updates network.wan_usb (proto dhcp) on the chosen tethering device with the metric you enter (default 20), adds it to the firewall zone named wan and brings it up.
items.usage_tip: With one tethering device it is picked automatically; with none you can type a device name (default usb0).

items.title: Toggle USB Tethering Interface
items.description: Disables wan_usb (ifdown + disabled=1) or enables it again (ifup).
items.usage_tip: Disabling keeps the configuration so it can be enabled later.

items.title: Failover Metric Rules
items.description: Backup: wan_usb metric 20 (or wan metric + 10). Primary: wan_usb 5 and wan 10. Custom: any metric. Lower metric is preferred.
items.usage_tip: When mwan3 runs, its member metrics decide failover instead.

items.title: USB ModeSwitch
items.description: Lists modems still in storage (CD-ROM) mode with usbmode -l and switches them to modem mode with usbmode -s.
items.usage_tip: Needs usb-modeswitch from the USB profile.

items.title: Remove USB Tethering WAN
items.description: Brings wan_usb down, deletes it and removes it from the wan firewall zone.
items.usage_tip: Multi-WAN (mwan3) still lists wan_usb until it is reconfigured.

items.title: Refresh Detection
items.usage_tip: Use after plugging in a phone or modem.

items.title: Install USB / Tethering Drivers
items.description: Opens the USB package profile plan and installs it after confirmation.

items.title: System Resources & Hardware Info
items.description: Architecture, OpenWrt release, RAM and storage usage.

items.title: Back to Main Menu
items.usage_tip: Nothing is changed by leaving this menu.

items.title: Quit DayPass
items.description: Ends the DayPass session from any menu.
items.usage_tip: Ctrl+C does the same and restores the terminal.

items.title: Help
items.description: Opens the manual of the current screen.
items.usage_tip: Enter or 0 inside a manual returns to the screen you came from; q quits DayPass.
